items.title: FAA issues nationwide ground stop for all flights due to ‘extraordinary circumstances’ and safety
items.brief: All flights in the United States are grounded until further notice “due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety,” the Federal Aviation Administration said in a statement.

items.title: Europe and Ukraine get a boost in peace talks, but Putin is playing for time
items.brief: At the airport in a freezing Moscow, the billionaire property developer and one of President Donald Trump’s top envoys, Steve Witkoff, fielded a brief question from a CNN team that had been ushered onto the tarmac.

items.title: Tanker collides with river cruiser near Port of New Orleans
items.brief: Emergency responders rushed to the Port of New Orleans after a tanker collided with a river cruise with more than 130 people onboard, according to port officials.
